cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. If you like this, we can save the proper stuff for guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not sacrificing breakfast to save you money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip. If it's awful, I'll buy you a croissant and keep my cup empty.

mechanism: A confidently chooses a household coffee economy but hands B veto and compensation to secure a first taste before filling A cup.
confusable: Unlike serving unfamiliar food, A own reliance waits on B test; confident selection must retreat into B control to keep the tasting voluntary.
comparison: Taste and breakfast compensation differ from physical splash testing and control of a tap.
seedUse: Use D32-b cheap substitute/proper coffee/croissant seed and S02-a claiming an adapted plan as leadership.
